observations: body L1-L2: the end of Delambre's quotation, begun on p. 194; his relations of the right-angled spherical triangle, sin perpendicular = sin hypotenuse sin base angle and cos hypotenuse = cos base cos perpendicular, are right.
body L4, L10: the dashes of «al–Battānī» are long dashes (5.4 pt in L4).
body L12: the dash of «177,v.–178,r.» measures 5.5 pt, that before Schiaparelli's name 9.8 pt; the heavy bracket closes his addition, begun on p. 194.
body L13, L27, L32: the heads of the notes on chapters 19, 20 and 21, «Ad» and «caput» in small capitals, in the larger type of the heads.
body L14, L28, L33: in the heads, the dashes after «a)» measure 10.1, 8.6 and 8.9 pt and the dash of «33–34» 5.5 pt; transcribed as dashes and a long dash.
body L16: the minus sign is printed as a long dash (10.2 pt); it is set as a minus sign.
body L24: the rule is checked: it is rule (β) of chapter 13 (p. 189), sin m = R tg φ tg δ.
body L30: the dash of «90–108» is a long dash.
body L35: «[meridianae]» stands in square brackets in the print.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
